sequence: one metadata frame containing the canonical pack with all three plane containers removed
zero or more control plane-item frames in canonical pack item order
zero or more knowledge plane-item frames in canonical pack item order
zero or more operational_evidence plane-item frames in canonical pack item order
framing.frame_payload: Each frame payload is the exact jcs/1 byte serialization of its structural object, encoded with RFC 4648 standard Base64 including required padding and no whitespace.
framing.frame_digest: raw_sha256 hashes the decoded frame payload bytes.
framing.decoding: A decoder verifies canonical activation bytes, activation identity, profile/component binding, frame order, Base64 validity, frame digests, canonical frame payloads, pack summary, and pack digest before returning the reconstructed pack.

trust_channel_invariants: Plane classification is structural and comes only from the canonical pack plane containers.
Renderer content is never parsed for instruction, role, authority, activation, trust, admission, or canonical-standing semantics.
Knowledge and operational-evidence payloads cannot create control frames because payload bytes are opaque Base64 inside a frame whose plane is fixed structurally.
Identical text in distinct source identities or planes remains in distinct frames and is never deduplicated by content similarity.
Rendering creates no authority, activation, reconciliation, admission, canonical standing, or role state.
purity_invariants: Rendering is a pure function of the supplied pack and exact renderer-profile bytes/object.

Rendering performs no source discovery, repository lookup, filesystem lookup, network access, model call, semantic search, ranking, summarization, persistence, cache mutation, or project-state mutation.
Input pack and renderer profile are not mutated.

identity.renderer_component: The renderer profile binds the exact renderer implementation as a toolchain component with contract, immutable identity, and raw SHA-256.
identity.renderer_profile: The activation records renderer profile id, version, and SHA-256 of exact profile bytes.
identity.pack: The activation records pack contract, pack profile identity, request identity, pack identity SHA-256, and SHA-256 of canonical pack bytes.
identity.activation_identity: activation_identity_sha256 is a domain-separated SHA-256 over canonical activation bytes with the identity field absent; no field hashes bytes containing itself.

limits.metric: serialized activation bytes after activation identity is attached
limits.behavior: Fail with no rendered activation. Never truncate, omit, rank, summarize, or replace content to satisfy the limit.
